portableAdaptations.reason: Optional internal per-component path guard enforces configured mount masking before each lookup, including symlink-expanded components and missing leaves. KernelWasi supplies the existing policy through its internal descriptor context; generic WASI defaults and the Storage contract remain unchanged.
Shared stdio types moved unchanged into a leaf module to avoid a type-only descriptor/open-description cycle. Original descriptor exports remain available.
Opted-in stdio receives shared descriptor flags and provides synchronous NONBLOCK I/O or EAGAIN; pipe providers honor the flag while poll remains the readiness path.

Optional internal argument transforms decode explicit guest ABI preopen operands before JSPI wrappers. Configured kernel CPU scopes charge WASM exports as user work and synchronous import steps as system work, pausing the user scope during suspension. Reactor entry and exit always release the active flag even when the accounting clock fails; unconfigured WASI behavior remains unchanged.
An optional synchronous step wrapper lets kernel CPU accounting measure generator work without charging the Promises yielded for I/O. The default step runner preserves generic WASI behavior.

Internal process creation policy delegates atomic inode metadata creation to the shared filesystem and consumes guest mode hints per syscall. The upstream Storage contract and default WASI behavior remain unchanged.
